_provenance.source: fiches Promevs Data, relevees a la main les 25 aout 2026
_provenance.pourquoi: Le client 1.8.1.2 ne nomme pas ces passifs. Quatre existent dans ItemTable_Equip_Passive_Base avec leur icone et leurs trois niveaux (epeq_howzer_d, epeq_bug_d, epeq_griamore_d, epeq_king_d) mais aucune langue ne les traduit ; les autres n'y sont pas du tout.
_provenance.aRemplacer: Des qu'un export d'un build plus recent nommera ces passifs, relire ItemTable_Equip_Passive_Base et la localisation plutot que ce fichier.
_provenance.structure: chaque passif a trois niveaux, de chance decroissante 60 / 30 / 10 %
_provenance.langue: textes en anglais, tels que publies
_provenance.couverture: Les 19 armures sont tranchees : 10 passifs releves sur fiches, 2 lus dans le client, 7 sans passif.

niveaux.texte: Each hit on an enemy with the Normal Skill increases Barrier Efficiency by 0.6% for 3 sec. (Max: 30%) When this effect reaches its max, it grants all allied heroes a barrier equal to 80% of Attack for 20 sec. (Cooldown: 30 sec.)

Each hit on an enemy with the Normal Skill increases Barrier Efficiency by 0.7% for 3 sec. (Max: 35%) When this effect reaches its max, it grants all allied heroes a barrier equal to 85% of Attack for 20 sec. (Cooldown: 30 sec.)

Each hit on an enemy with the Normal Skill increases Barrier Efficiency by 0.8% for 3 sec. (Max: 40%) When this effect reaches its max, it grants all allied heroes a barrier equal to 90% of Attack for 20 sec. (Cooldown: 30 sec.)
Attacking a Taunted enemy applies Curse on them for 10 sec. Increases allied heroes' Darkness damage dealt to enemies with reduced Darkness Resistance by 18%.
Attacking a Taunted enemy applies Curse on them for 13 sec. Increases allied heroes' Darkness damage dealt to enemies with reduced Darkness Resistance by 24%.
Attacking a Taunted enemy applies Curse on them for 16 sec. Increases allied heroes' Darkness damage dealt to enemies with reduced Darkness Resistance by 30%.

Each hit on an enemy with the Special Attack inflicts additional damage equal to 24% of Attack, and Daze for 10 sec if the enemy is not Stunned or Dazed. Enemies affected by Daze have their Movement Speed decreased by 10%. Satisfies the conditions of any skill that requires the enemy to be Stunned.

Each hit on an enemy with the Special Attack inflicts additional damage equal to 32% of Attack, and Daze for 10 sec if the enemy is not Stunned or Dazed. Enemies affected by Daze have their Movement Speed decreased by 20%. Satisfies the conditions of any skill that requires the enemy to be Stunned.

Each hit on an enemy with the Special Attack inflicts additional damage equal to 40% of Attack, and Daze for 10 sec if the enemy is not Stunned or Dazed. Enemies affected by Daze have their Movement Speed decreased by 30%. Satisfies the conditions of any skill that requires the enemy to be Stunned.

Each time Defense boost is gained, all allied Earth heroes' Crit Damage increases by 6% for 20 sec. (Max: 30%) When the hero uses the Ultimate Move, it increases all allied Earth heroes' Attack and Defense by 12% for 10 sec.

Each time Defense boost is gained, all allied Earth heroes' Crit Damage increases by 7% for 20 sec. (Max: 35%) When the hero uses the Ultimate Move, it increases all allied Earth heroes' Attack and Defense by 16% for 10 sec.

Each time Defense boost is gained, all allied Earth heroes' Crit Damage increases by 8% for 20 sec. (Max: 40%) When the hero uses the Ultimate Move, it increases all allied Earth heroes' Attack and Defense by 20% for 10 sec.

Each hit on an enemy with an Earth attack while their Earth Burst Gauge is 50% or below increases the Burst Gauge by a fixed value of 60. When the hero activates an Earth Burst, it increases all allied heroes' Earth Attack by 6% of the hero's Attack for 30 sec. (Max: 1800)

Each hit on an enemy with an Earth attack while their Earth Burst Gauge is 50% or below increases the Burst Gauge by a fixed value of 80. When the hero activates an Earth Burst, it increases all allied heroes' Earth Attack by 8% of the hero's Attack for 30 sec. (Max: 2400)

(Max: 12%) When this effect reaches its max, it is replaced by an effect that increases all allied Lightning heroes' Normal Skill damage by 18% and Movement Speed by 30% for 15 sec. (Does not stack)
